title: Questions 186-190 refer to the following memo, press release, and e-mail.
passage_1:
MEMO

To:All Staff
From:Adaeze Nwosu, CEO, Halcyon Instruments
Date:26 March
Subject:Volunteer Opportunity at Wren Meadow

At Halcyon Instruments we are very proud of our staff members’ proven readiness to take part in local community conservation events. That is why I would like to tell you about another chance to help. The manager of Wren Meadow nature reserve, Delia Fontaine, is looking for assistance with the annual scrub-clearance day this Saturday morning.

If you are willing to lend a hand, please notify Marcus Hale in the human resources department before noon on Thursday. He will add your name to the list and give you further details. The clearance day is scheduled to begin at 8:30 A.M. sharp and will last roughly four hours. Our operations director, Yuki Tanaka, will provide lunch for everyone once the work is finished.

18 April

The Borough of Kelbourne would like to thank everyone who came out to Wren Meadow on Saturday, 11 April, to help prepare the reserve for the summer. Despite the rain, nearly 40 local residents worked from 9:30 A.M. until 1:30 P.M. clearing scrub, repairing footpaths, and carrying out a range of other tasks. The reserve has never looked better!

We would also like to extend our gratitude to the local firms that agreed to fund the building of a new wildlife preservation area at the reserve. The heads of these companies will be invited to a special ceremony on 20 June to mark the opening of the preservation area and to receive a Community Partner Award from Mayor Ellery.

To:Astrid Lindqvist <a.lindqvist@vaneska.com>
From:Ravi Bhatt <r.bhatt@kelbourne.gov.uk>
Date:5 June
Subject:This Month

Dear Ms. Lindqvist,

As you will know, the ceremony at Wren Meadow takes place this month. Please let me know whether you intend to be there. I would be grateful if you could do this by 10 June. If you are unable to make it, you may send one of your employees in your place. Please note, however, that Mayor Ellery has indicated a strong preference for the heads of the recipient firms to accept the award in person at the ceremony on 20 June.

Do get in touch if you have any further questions.

Sincerely,
Ravi Bhatt
Events Officer
Borough of Kelbourne
